3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.
3.name: Bright Harbinger

4.description:
Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain |cffffff1600|r damage done for |cffffff3.1|r seconds. This bonus is halved against players.
4.name: Judgment's Brand

5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by |cffffff20|r% while stationary.
5.name: Steadfast Candescence

1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Upgrades rank 2 of Hemorrhage to have a chance to generate |cffffff2|r Ultimate while in combat. This effect can occur once every |cffffff0.3|r seconds and the chance is equal to your Weapon Critical chance.
1.name: Nocturnal Inspiration

2.description:
Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.
2.name: An Eye for Exploitation

3.description:
An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff25|r%. This effect is reduced to |cffffff5|r% against targets with Battle Spirit.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.
3.name: Above and Beyond

4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, increasing to |cffffff20|r seconds against monsters.
4.name: Cutthroat's Focus

5.description:
Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

Upgrades rank 2 of Transfer to grant group members |cffffff250|r Magicka and Stamina, |cffffff2|r Ultimate, and doubles the Ultimate you gain when it activates.
5.name: Share the Spoils

1.description:
Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

Upgrades rank 2 of Blood Magic to work with all abilities with a cost, excluding cost per tick abilities, and restores |cffffff229|r Magicka and |cffffff323|r Stamina when it activates. This effect scales off your Max Magicka and Stamina.
1.name: Conservation of Energy

2.description:
Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power.

Upgrades rank 2 of Exploitation to work with any Sorcerer ability and increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff12|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds. The Weapon and Spell Damage increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1750|r Max Magicka or Stamina you have, whichever is higher.
2.name: Font of Power

3.description:
The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

When you deal damage with a Sorcerer ability, you have a |cffffff20|r% chance to deal |cffffff1397|r Shock Damage, up to once every |cffffff0.1|r seconds. 

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.
3.name: Static Reverberation

4.description:
Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

While beginning to use a Sorcerer ability or an ability with a cast time, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff0.5|r seconds that can absorb |cffffff6815|r damage. This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.
4.name: Calculated Defense

5.description:
Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff3098|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.
5.name: Sphere of Influence

Current bonus: |cffffff10|r%.

Reduces the cost of Sneak by |cffffff7|r% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped.

35.name: Antiquarian Insight

36.name: Soul Summons

37.description:
When your Health drops below |cffffff20|r% your soul explodes, dealing |cffffff2012|r Magic Damage to enemies within |cffffff8|r meters of you.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r minutes and scales off your Max Health.
37.name: Soul Shatter

38.description: Killing an enemy has a |cffffff10|r% chance of automatically filling an empty Soul Gem.
38.name: Soul Lock

39.description:
Allows you to feed on an unsuspecting target, killing them and increasing your Vampire Stage. Higher Stages make you a stronger Vampire at the cost of your humanity. Stages decrease over long periods of time. 

Stage 1/2/3/4

Health Recovery: -10%/-30%/-60%/-100%
Flame Damage Taken: +5%/+8%/+13%/+20%
Regular Ability Costs: +3%/+5%/+8%/+12%
Vampire Ability Costs: -6%/-10%/-16%/-24%
39.name: Feed

40.description:
Ignore the Movement Speed penalty of Sneak.

Decreases the time it takes to enter Sneak by |cffffff50|r%.
40.name: Dark Stalker

41.description:
Reduces the cost of Sprint by |cffffff50|r%.

If you continuously Sprint for |cffffff3|r seconds you automatically become invisible.
41.name: Unnatural Movement

42.description:
Call the weapon of the Dark Brotherhood to your hand and deliver a killing blow to an unsuspecting target. Experience from this target is reduced by 75%.

This ability does not work on players or difficult targets.
42.name: Blade of Woe

43.description: Bounty and Heat resulting from a witnessed Murder or Assault is reduced by |cffffff50|r%.
43.name: Scales of Pitiless Justice

44.description: Grants Major Expedition, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds after killing an enemy with Blade of Woe.
44.name: Padomaic Sprint

45.description: A contact from the Brotherhood provides beneficial items once per day. This contact is located in Outlaw Refuges, the Gold Coast Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, and the Hew's Bane Thieves Den.
45.name: Shadowy Supplier

46.description: Aggression radius from hostile monsters is decreased by 50% while mounted.
46.name: Shadow Rider

47.description: 15% chance to shroud you when using the Blade of Woe, shielding you from being witnessed and receiving a Bounty.
47.name: Spectral Assassin

48.description:
Allows you to Intimidate NPCs in conversation.

Reduces the Stamina cost of your Fighters Guild abilities by |cffffff15|r%.
48.name: Intimidating Presence

49.description: Allows you to Persuade NPCs in conversation.
49.name: Persuasive Will

50.description: The insight you have gained from the Psijic Order grants you vision of the spiritual world. You can now interact with rifts all throughout Tamriel.
50.name: See the Unseen

51.description: Thieves troves are caches that are located all over Tamriel. They can only be opened by members of the Thieves Guild.
51.name: Finders Keepers

52.description:
Bounty is decreased by |cffffff115|r after |cFFFFFF3|r minutes.
Heat is decreased by |cffffff64|r after |cFFFFFF3|r seconds.
52.name: Swiftly Forgotten

53.description: Stolen items sold at a fence are worth |cffffff10|r% more. Does not apply to Laundering.
53.name: Haggling

54.description: When a guard accosts you, you may use Clemency once per day. If used, the Guard will not arrest you or take your money and stolen goods. Additionally, Guards will not attempt to accost you for  |cFFFFFF1|r minute after you use Clemency unless you commit other crimes.
54.name: Clemency

55.description: When you have Bounty and are in combat, you have a chance to spot a "Footpad" in a town with a Refuge. Interacting with the Footpad will transport the player safely into the nearest Refuge.
55.name: Timely Escape

56.description: Decreases detection range of Witnesses and Guards by |cffffff10|r%. Witnesses and Guards are thus less likely to notice criminal actions, though this has no impact on the range from which Guards will accost you.
56.name: Veil of Shadows

57.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff5|r% and Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by |cffffff10|r% for |cffffff10|r minutes after you capture a Lumber Mill, Farm, Mine, or Keep.

Gain Gallop at all times, increasing your Mount Speed by |cffffff15|r%.
57.name: Continuous Attack

58.description:
Increases your experience gain with the Two Handed skill line by |cffffff15|r%.

Increases the duration of any consumed drink by |cffffff15|r minutes.
58.name: Reveler

5.name: Fated Fortune

6.description:
You master the warp and weft of your very soul. 

When you restore Magicka or Stamina, your Weapon and Spell Damage increase by |cffffff284|r for |cffffff10|r seconds.
6.name: Harnessed Quintessence

7.description: Your attacks wound the mind with heretical knowledge, increasing damage dealt by Status Effects by |cffffff15|r% and Status Effect Chance by |cffffff55|r%.
7.name: Psychic Lesion

8.description:
What they don't know can kill them. Increase your Physical and Spell Penetration by |cffffff1240|r per Herald of the Tome ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff3720|r.

9.effect: Increases your Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r%.

10.name: Sneak
10.effect:
You are concealed from enemy sight, as long as you remain undetected. While Sneaking, your next Direct Damage attack will Critically Strike and gain bonus effects depending on the attack type, as long the target isn't facing you.

- Melee Attacks stun the first enemy hit for |cffffff2|r seconds and gain maximum Critical Damage against monsters.
- Ranged Attacks gain |cffffff50|r% Critical Damage against monsters.

1.name: Inspired Scholarship
1.description:
Etch a series of runes onto your weapon that pulse with power once every |cffffff3|r seconds. Each pulse enhances your Arcanist skills, and striking an enemy with one deals an additional |cffffff2891|r Magic Damage and generates Crux if you have none.

While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

2.name: Cephaliarch's Flail
2.description:
Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing |cffffff6330|r Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

If an enemy is hit, you for heal for |cffffff2788|r Health, once per cast.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

3.name: Pragmatic Fatecarver
3.description:
Channel a beam of energy in front of you for up to |cffffff4|r seconds, dealing |cffffff2869|r Magic Damage every |cffffff0.3|r seconds to up to 6 enemies. While channeling, you also gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff8980|r damage and grants interrupt immunity.

Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by |cffffff33|r%, and decreases cost by |cffffff16|r% per Crux spent.

This ability is considered direct damage.

4.name: Killer's Blade
4.description:
Thrust a caustic blade with lethal precision to stab an enemy, dealing |cffffff3588|r Disease Damage. Deals up to |cffffff400|r% more damage to enemies with less than |cffffff50|r% Health.

Heals you for |cffffff6681|r if the enemy dies within |cffffff2|r seconds of being struck.

5.name: Relentless Focus
5.description:
When slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

Your Light and Heavy Attacks now generate a stack of Relentless Focus, up to |cffffff10|r times. Fully-charged Heavy Attacks grant two stacks.

When at |cffffff4|r or more stacks, you can consume |cffffff4|r to fire a spectral arrow to deal |cffffff12919|r Disease Damage and heal for |cffffff34|r% of the damage dealt, if you are in melee range.

6.name: Soul Harvest
6.description:
Ravage an enemy with a spinning attack, dealing |cffffff11484|r Magic Damage and increasing your damage against them by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff8|r seconds.

Also afflicts the enemy with Major Defile, reducing their healing received and damage shield strength by |cffffff12|r%.

While slotted on either bar, any time you kill an enemy you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.

1.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
1.name: Inexorable Descent

2.description:
Let your voice echo across the peaks.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice now also grants |cffffff5|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for every Ultimate spent for |cffffff10|r seconds after a delay of |cffffff15|r seconds.
2.name: Booming Voice

3.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4578|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
3.name: Wildfire Embers

4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.
4.name: Resolute Defense

5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Lead from the Front

1.description:
Dive deep into the abyss where power is yours to claim.

Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you |cffffff666|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff15|r seconds.
1.name: Abyssal Emergence

2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.
2.name: Fate Realigned

3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.
3.name: Unbound Potential

4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
4.name: Erudite's Rigor

5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.
5.name: Ink-Scribe's Verve

1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.
1.name: Nothing Wasted

2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
2.name: Malevolent Promise

3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.
3.name: Cycle Unending

4.description:
Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff1832|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.
4.name: Pound of Flesh

5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.
5.name: Veil's Forfeit

1.description:
Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold.

Upgrades Chilled to also apply Major Brittle for |cffffff2.1|r seconds, increasing their Critical Damage taken by |cffffff20|r%.
1.name: Tundra's Maw

2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

Gain |cffffff333|r Weapon and Spell Damage for each status effect on your target, up to a maximum of |cffffff1665|r.
2.name: Wild Adaptation

3.description:
Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

Upgrades Bond with Nature to also activate when casting Winter's Embrace abilities and to grant |cffffff15|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff10|r seconds if you are at full Health after the heal.
3.name: Glacial Obstinance

4.description:
The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff3|r% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of |cffffff15|r%.
4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide

5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds and an additional |cffffff125|r Magicka and Stamina, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
5.name: Bountiful Harvest

1.description:
Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff1465|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.
1.name: Bastion of Light

2.description:
Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff4131|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.
2.name: Devout Guardian

3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.
3.name: Bright Harbinger

4.description:
Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain |cffffff1600|r damage done for |cffffff3.1|r seconds. This bonus is halved against players.
4.name: Judgment's Brand

5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by |cffffff20|r% while stationary.
5.name: Steadfast Candescence

1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Upgrades rank 2 of Hemorrhage to have a chance to generate |cffffff2|r Ultimate while in combat. This effect can occur once every |cffffff0.3|r seconds and the chance is equal to your Weapon Critical chance.
1.name: Nocturnal Inspiration

2.description:
Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.
2.name: An Eye for Exploitation

3.description:

Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you |cffffff666|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff15|r seconds.
1.name: Abyssal Emergence

2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.
2.name: Fate Realigned

3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.
3.name: Unbound Potential

4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
4.name: Erudite's Rigor

5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.
5.name: Ink-Scribe's Verve

1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.
1.name: Nothing Wasted

2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
2.name: Malevolent Promise

3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.
3.name: Cycle Unending

4.description:
Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff1832|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.
4.name: Pound of Flesh

5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.
5.name: Veil's Forfeit

1.description:
Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold.

Upgrades Chilled to also apply Major Brittle for |cffffff2.1|r seconds, increasing their Critical Damage taken by |cffffff20|r%.
1.name: Tundra's Maw

2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

Gain |cffffff333|r Weapon and Spell Damage for each status effect on your target, up to a maximum of |cffffff1665|r.
2.name: Wild Adaptation

3.description:
Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

Upgrades Bond with Nature to also activate when casting Winter's Embrace abilities and to grant |cffffff15|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff10|r seconds if you are at full Health after the heal.
3.name: Glacial Obstinance

4.description:
The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff3|r% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of |cffffff15|r%.
4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide

5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds and an additional |cffffff125|r Magicka and Stamina, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
5.name: Bountiful Harvest

1.description:
Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff1465|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.
1.name: Bastion of Light

2.description:
Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff4131|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.
2.name: Devout Guardian

3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.
3.name: Bright Harbinger

4.description:
Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain |cffffff1600|r damage done for |cffffff3.1|r seconds. This bonus is halved against players.
4.name: Judgment's Brand

5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by |cffffff20|r% while stationary.
5.name: Steadfast Candescence

1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Upgrades rank 2 of Hemorrhage to have a chance to generate |cffffff2|r Ultimate while in combat. This effect can occur once every |cffffff0.3|r seconds and the chance is equal to your Weapon Critical chance.
1.name: Nocturnal Inspiration

2.description:
Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.
2.name: An Eye for Exploitation

3.description:
An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff25|r%. This effect is reduced to |cffffff5|r% against targets with Battle Spirit.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.
3.name: Above and Beyond

4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, increasing to |cffffff20|r seconds against monsters.
4.name: Cutthroat's Focus

5.description:
Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

Upgrades rank 2 of Transfer to grant group members |cffffff250|r Magicka and Stamina, |cffffff2|r Ultimate, and doubles the Ultimate you gain when it activates.
5.name: Share the Spoils

1.description:
Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

Upgrades rank 2 of Blood Magic to work with all abilities with a cost, excluding cost per tick abilities, and restores |cffffff229|r Magicka and |cffffff323|r Stamina when it activates. This effect scales off your Max Magicka and Stamina.
1.name: Conservation of Energy

2.description:
Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power.

Upgrades rank 2 of Exploitation to work with any Sorcerer ability and increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff12|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds. The Weapon and Spell Damage increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1750|r Max Magicka or Stamina you have, whichever is higher.
2.name: Font of Power

3.description:
The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

When you deal damage with a Sorcerer ability, you have a |cffffff20|r% chance to deal |cffffff1397|r Shock Damage, up to once every |cffffff0.1|r seconds. 

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.
3.name: Static Reverberation

4.description:
Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

While beginning to use a Sorcerer ability or an ability with a cast time, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff0.5|r seconds that can absorb |cffffff6815|r damage. This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.
4.name: Calculated Defense

5.description:
Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff3098|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.
5.name: Sphere of Influence

When your Health drops below |cffffff20|r% your soul explodes, dealing |cffffff2012|r Magic Damage to enemies within |cffffff8|r meters of you.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r minutes and scales off your Max Health.
37.name: Soul Shatter

38.name: Soul Lock

Allows you to feed on an unsuspecting target, killing them and increasing your Vampire Stage. Higher Stages make you a stronger Vampire at the cost of your humanity. Stages decrease over long periods of time. 

Stage 1/2/3/4

48.description:

Reduces the Stamina cost of your Fighters Guild abilities by |cffffff15|r%.

49.description: Allows you to Persuade NPCs in conversation.

54.name: Clemency

56.description: Decreases detection range of Witnesses and Guards by |cffffff10|r%. Witnesses and Guards are thus less likely to notice criminal actions, though this has no impact on the range from which Guards will accost you.
56.name: Veil of Shadows

You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times.

5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.

2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.
3.name: Unbound Potential

4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
4.name: Erudite's Rigor

5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.
1.name: Nothing Wasted

2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.

3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.

Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff1832|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.

5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.

Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold.

2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.

Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff4131|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.

Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health.

An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.

This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power.

Upgrades rank 2 of Exploitation to work with any Sorcerer ability and increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff12|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds. The Weapon and Spell Damage increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1750|r Max Magicka or Stamina you have, whichever is higher.

The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

When you deal damage with a Sorcerer ability, you have a |cffffff20|r% chance to deal |cffffff1397|r Shock Damage, up to once every |cffffff0.1|r seconds. 

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.

Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.

5.description:
Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff3098|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.

Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff1832|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.
4.name: Pound of Flesh

5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.
5.name: Veil's Forfeit

1.description:
Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold.

2.description:

4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide

5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

5.name: Bountiful Harvest

Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.

Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff4131|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.
3.name: Bright Harbinger

4.name: Judgment's Brand

5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by |cffffff20|r% while stationary.
5.name: Steadfast Candescence

The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Upgrades rank 2 of Hemorrhage to have a chance to generate |cffffff2|r Ultimate while in combat. This effect can occur once every |cffffff0.3|r seconds and the chance is equal to your Weapon Critical chance.

Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

51.name: Finders Keepers

52.description:
Bounty is decreased by |cffffff115|r after |cFFFFFF3|r minutes.
Heat is decreased by |cffffff64|r after |cFFFFFF3|r seconds.
52.name: Swiftly Forgotten

53.description: Stolen items sold at a fence are worth |cffffff10|r% more. Does not apply to Laundering.
53.name: Haggling

54.description: When a guard accosts you, you may use Clemency once per day. If used, the Guard will not arrest you or take your money and stolen goods. Additionally, Guards will not attempt to accost you for  |cFFFFFF1|r minute after you use Clemency unless you commit other crimes.
54.name: Clemency

55.description: When you have Bounty and are in combat, you have a chance to spot a "Footpad" in a town with a Refuge. Interacting with the Footpad will transport the player safely into the nearest Refuge.
55.name: Timely Escape

56.description: Decreases detection range of Witnesses and Guards by |cffffff10|r%. Witnesses and Guards are thus less likely to notice criminal actions, though this has no impact on the range from which Guards will accost you.
56.name: Veil of Shadows

57.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff5|r% and Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by |cffffff10|r% for |cffffff10|r minutes after you capture a Lumber Mill, Farm, Mine, or Keep.

Gain Gallop at all times, increasing your Mount Speed by |cffffff15|r%.
57.name: Continuous Attack

58.description:
Increases your experience gain with the Two Handed skill line by |cffffff15|r%.

Increases the duration of any consumed drink by |cffffff15|r minutes.
58.name: Reveler

1.name: Master Assassin

2.description: When an enemy dies within |cffffff2|r seconds of being damaged by you, you restore |cffffff1000|r Magicka and Stamina.
2.name: Executioner

Increases your Critical Chance rating by |cffffff438|r for each Nightblade ability slotted, increasing your chance to critically strike by |cffffff2|r% per ability.

3.name: Pressure Points

4.description:
Increases your Critical Damage by |cffffff10|r%. 

Critically striking in any form grants you and your group Minor Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff6|r% for |cffffff20|r seconds.
4.name: Hemorrhage

5.description: Warp fate when you generate or consume Crux, increasing your Critical Damage and Critical Healing by |cffffff12|r% for |cffffff7|r seconds.
5.name: Fated Fortune

6.description:
You master the warp and weft of your very soul. 

When you restore Magicka or Stamina, your Weapon and Spell Damage increase by |cffffff284|r for |cffffff10|r seconds.
6.name: Harnessed Quintessence

7.description: Your attacks wound the mind with heretical knowledge, increasing damage dealt by Status Effects by |cffffff15|r% and Status Effect Chance by |cffffff55|r%.
7.name: Psychic Lesion

8.description:
What they don't know can kill them. Increase your Physical and Spell Penetration by |cffffff1240|r per Herald of the Tome ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff3720|r.
8.name: Splintered Secrets

1.name: Inspired Scholarship
1.description:
Etch a series of runes onto your weapon that pulse with power once every |cffffff3|r seconds. Each pulse enhances your Arcanist skills, and striking an enemy with one deals an additional |cffffff2950|r Magic Damage and generates Crux if you have none.

While slotted on either ability bar, gain Major Brutality, increasing your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff20|r%.

2.name: Cephaliarch's Flail
2.description:
Infuse your arm with abyssal magic to form tentacles that lash out at your foes dealing |cffffff6462|r Physical Damage and generating Crux. Enemies are immobilized for |cffffff3|r seconds and marked with Abyssal Ink for |cffffff20|r seconds.

If an enemy is hit, you for heal for |cffffff2850|r Health, once per cast.

You deal |cffffff5|r% increased damage to enemies drenched in Abyssal Ink.

3.name: Pragmatic Fatecarver
3.description:
Channel a beam of energy in front of you for up to |cffffff4|r seconds, dealing |cffffff2930|r Magic Damage every |cffffff0.3|r seconds to up to 6 enemies. While channeling, you also gain a damage shield that absorbs up to |cffffff8980|r damage and grants interrupt immunity.

Casting Pragmatic Fatecarver consumes all Crux and increases damage done by |cffffff33|r%, and decreases cost by |cffffff16|r% per Crux spent.

This ability is considered direct damage.

4.name: Killer's Blade
4.description:
Thrust a caustic blade with lethal precision to stab an enemy, dealing |cffffff3663|r Disease Damage. Deals up to |cffffff400|r% more damage to enemies with less than |cffffff50|r% Health.

Heals you for |cffffff6829|r if the enemy dies within |cffffff2|r seconds of being struck.

5.name: Relentless Focus
5.description:
When slotted on either bar, gain Major Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff12|r%.

Your Light and Heavy Attacks now generate a stack of Relentless Focus, up to |cffffff10|r times. Fully-charged Heavy Attacks grant two stacks.

When at |cffffff4|r or more stacks, you can consume |cffffff4|r to fire a spectral arrow to deal |cffffff13189|r Disease Damage and heal for |cffffff34|r% of the damage dealt, if you are in melee range.

6.name: Soul Harvest
6.description:
Ravage an enemy with a spinning attack, dealing |cffffff11723|r Magic Damage and increasing your damage against them by |cffffff20|r% for |cffffff8|r seconds.

Also afflicts the enemy with Major Defile, reducing their healing received and damage shield strength by |cffffff12|r%.

While slotted on either bar, any time you kill an enemy you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.

1.description:
Be as the landslide. Let nothing stop you.

Improves your Landslide passive to increase the potency of your damage done, healing done, and damage shield strength by |cffffff1|r% per stack.
1.name: Inexorable Descent

2.description:
Let your voice echo across the peaks.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice now also grants |cffffff5|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for every Ultimate spent for |cffffff10|r seconds after a delay of |cffffff15|r seconds.
2.name: Booming Voice

3.description:
Fire forged within can never be extinguished. Fan the flames.

When your Dragonknight damage over time effects end, you apply a stack of Wildfire Embers to the target, dealing |cffffff4676|r Flame Damage over |cffffff12|r seconds. This effect stacks up to |cffffff12|r times and increases in damage |cffffff25|r% per stack.
3.name: Wildfire Embers

4.description:
You are as unyielding as a mountain.

Each second you remain Bracing, you increase the amount of damage you block by |cffffff6|r%, up to 5 times. 

Blocking damage has a |cffffff20|r% chance to restore |cffffff500|r Stamina. This effect can occur once every block cost.
4.name: Resolute Defense

5.description:
Let others be swept along in the wake of your flame.

Activating rank 2 of The Storm Voice grants you and group members within |cffffff28|r meters of you Major Berserk and Protection for |cffffff1|r second per |cffffff15|r Ultimate spent, increasing damage done and reducing damage taken by |cffffff10|r%.
5.name: Lead from the Front

1.description:
Dive deep into the abyss where power is yours to claim.

Activating an Arcanist Ultimate immediately generates maximum Crux and grants you |cffffff666|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff15|r seconds.
1.name: Abyssal Emergence

2.description:
Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.
2.name: Fate Realigned

3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.
3.name: Unbound Potential

4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
4.name: Erudite's Rigor

5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.
5.name: Ink-Scribe's Verve

1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.
1.name: Nothing Wasted

2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
2.name: Malevolent Promise

3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.
3.name: Cycle Unending

4.description:
Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff1832|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.
4.name: Pound of Flesh

5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.
5.name: Veil's Forfeit

1.description:
Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold.

Upgrades Chilled to also apply Major Brittle for |cffffff2.1|r seconds, increasing their Critical Damage taken by |cffffff20|r%.
1.name: Tundra's Maw

2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

Gain |cffffff333|r Weapon and Spell Damage for each status effect on your target, up to a maximum of |cffffff1665|r.
2.name: Wild Adaptation

3.description:
Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

Upgrades Bond with Nature to also activate when casting Winter's Embrace abilities and to grant |cffffff15|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff10|r seconds if you are at full Health after the heal.
3.name: Glacial Obstinance

4.description:
The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff3|r% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of |cffffff15|r%.
4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide

5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds and an additional |cffffff125|r Magicka and Stamina, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
5.name: Bountiful Harvest

1.description:
Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff1465|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.
1.name: Bastion of Light

2.description:
Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff4131|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.
2.name: Devout Guardian

3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.
3.name: Bright Harbinger

4.description:
Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain |cffffff1600|r damage done for |cffffff3.1|r seconds. This bonus is halved against players.
4.name: Judgment's Brand

5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by |cffffff20|r% while stationary.
5.name: Steadfast Candescence

1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Upgrades rank 2 of Hemorrhage to have a chance to generate |cffffff2|r Ultimate while in combat. This effect can occur once every |cffffff0.3|r seconds and the chance is equal to your Weapon Critical chance.
1.name: Nocturnal Inspiration

2.description:
Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.
2.name: An Eye for Exploitation

3.description:
An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff25|r%. This effect is reduced to |cffffff5|r% against targets with Battle Spirit.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.
3.name: Above and Beyond

4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, increasing to |cffffff20|r seconds against monsters.
4.name: Cutthroat's Focus

5.description:
Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

Upgrades rank 2 of Transfer to grant group members |cffffff250|r Magicka and Stamina, |cffffff2|r Ultimate, and doubles the Ultimate you gain when it activates.
5.name: Share the Spoils

1.description:
Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

Upgrades rank 2 of Blood Magic to work with all abilities with a cost, excluding cost per tick abilities, and restores |cffffff229|r Magicka and |cffffff323|r Stamina when it activates. This effect scales off your Max Magicka and Stamina.
1.name: Conservation of Energy

2.description:
Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power.

Upgrades rank 2 of Exploitation to work with any Sorcerer ability and increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff12|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds. The Weapon and Spell Damage increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1750|r Max Magicka or Stamina you have, whichever is higher.
2.name: Font of Power

3.description:
The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

When you deal damage with a Sorcerer ability, you have a |cffffff20|r% chance to deal |cffffff1441|r Shock Damage, up to once every |cffffff0.1|r seconds. 

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.
3.name: Static Reverberation

4.description:
Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

While beginning to use a Sorcerer ability or an ability with a cast time, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff0.5|r seconds that can absorb |cffffff6815|r damage. This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.
4.name: Calculated Defense

5.description:
Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff3098|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.
5.name: Sphere of Influence

1.description: Your Light and Heavy Attacks damage up to |cffffff3|r other nearby enemies for |cffffff100|r% of the damage inflicted to the primary target.
1.name: Forceful

2.description:
Grants a bonus based on the type of weapon equipped:

Swords increase your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff258|r.

Axes increase your Critical Damage done by |cffffff12|r%.

Maces increase your Offensive Penetration by |cffffff2974|r.
2.name: Heavy Weapons

3.description: Reduces the Stamina cost of your Two-Handed abilities by |cffffff15|r%.
3.name: Balanced Blade

4.description: When you complete a fully-charged Heavy Attack, your damage done with Two Handed attacks increases by |cffffff10|r% for |cffffff4|r seconds.
4.name: Follow Up

5.description: Increases your Stamina Recovery by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds after killing a target.
5.name: Battle Rush

6.description:
Each piece of Light Armor does the following:

Reduces damage taken from Magical attacks by |cffffff1|r%

Reduces the cost of Roll Dodge by |cffffff3|r%

Reduces the Movement Speed penalty of Sneak by |cffffff5|r%

Reduces the cost of Break Free by |cffffff5|r%

Reduces the cost of Bash by |cffffff3|r%
6.name: Light Armor Bonuses

7.description:
Each piece of Light Armor does the following:

Increases damage taken from Martial attacks by |cffffff1|r%

Increases the cost of Block by |cffffff3|r%

Decreases damage done with Bash by |cffffff1|r%
7.name: Light Armor Penalties

8.description:
Reduces the effectiveness of snares applied to you by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Light Armor worn.

Current bonus: |cffffff4|r%.

Reduces the cost of Sprint by |cffffff3|r% for each piece of Light Armor worn.

Current bonus: |cffffff3|r%.
8.name: Grace

9.description:
Increases your Magicka Recovery by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Light Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff4|r%.

Reduces the Magicka cost of your abilities by |cffffff2|r% for each piece of Light Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff2|r%.
9.name: Evocation

10.description:
Increases your Spell Resistance by |cffffff726|r for each piece of Light Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff726|r.
10.name: Spell Warding

11.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Critical rating by |cffffff219|r for each piece of Light Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff219|r.
11.name: Prodigy

12.description:
Increases your Physical and Spell Penetration by |cffffff939|r for each piece of Light Armor worn.

Current bonus: |cffffff939|r
12.name: Concentration

13.description:
Each piece of Medium Armor does the following:

Reduces the cost of Sprint by |cffffff1|r%

Reduces the cost of Sneak by |cffffff5|r%

Reduces the cost of Block by |cffffff3|r%

Reduces damage taken from Area of Effect attacks by |cffffff2|r% for |cffffff2|r seconds after you use Roll Dodge

Increases Movement Speed by |cffffff2|r% while immune to crowd control
13.name: Medium Armor Bonuses

14.description:
Increases your Critical Damage and Healing done rating by |cffffff2|r% for every piece of Medium Armor equipped.

Current bonus: |cffffff10|r%.
14.name: Dexterity

15.description:
Increases your Stamina Recovery by |cffffff4|r% per piece of Medium Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff20|r%.

Reduces the Stamina cost of your abilities by |cffffff2|r% per piece of Medium Armor equipped. 

Current bonus: |cffffff10|r%.
15.name: Wind Walker

16.description:

Be the hand that guides the weave of fate.

Upgrades rank 2 of Implacable Outcome to generate maximum Crux, up to once every |cffffff15|r seconds. After this effect triggers you gain |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff25|r seconds.
2.name: Fate Realigned

3.description:
Surpass your limits in the fieldwork of battle.

Upgrades rank 2 of Fated Fortune to also increase your damage done by |cffffff30|r%, halving against players, for the duration.
3.name: Unbound Potential

4.description:
Master the archaic and forge new runes of conflict.

Upgrades Fatewoven Armor to inflict Minor Cowardice on your attacker while granting Major Vitality to you and your group for |cffffff4|r seconds. You gain |cffffff1|r Ultimate for every Crux you have.

These effects can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
4.name: Erudite's Rigor

5.description:
Illuminate body and mind with glimmering ink.

While in combat, when you heal or overheal a total of |cffffff100000|r Health, you generate a Crux and grant you and your group members Major Force for |cffffff10|r seconds, increasing Critical Damage by |cffffff20|r%.
5.name: Ink-Scribe's Verve

1.description:
As an abattoir of death, no remnants of life are wasted.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to also grant a stack of Nothing Wasted for |cffffff12|r seconds, which increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% and Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% per stack, up to |cffffff10|r times. Stacks decay two at a time instead of all at once.
1.name: Nothing Wasted

2.description:
Death's knell is a familiar song. Share it with your enemies.

Upgrades rank 2 of Corpse Consumption to mark the closest non-player enemy to you with death's touch for |cffffff6|r seconds, allowing you to use a corpse consuming ability on them. Consuming or replacing this effect forcibly triggers rank 1 of Corpse Consumption's Ultimate generation and triggers rank 2 of Death Gleaning.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
2.name: Malevolent Promise

3.description:
The cycle of life and death continues: you will live, others will die.

Upgrades rank 2 of Reusable Parts to grant Cycle Unending for |cffffff25|r seconds, increasing the potency of your damage done by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% Health you have more than your target. The damage bonus caps at |cffffff25|r%, or |cffffff10|r% against players.
3.name: Cycle Unending

4.description:
Knock upon death's door and demand your due.

When you take damage you have a |cffffff10|r% chance to heal |cffffff1832|r Health and restore |cffffff5|r% of your missing Stamina, up to once per second. This chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every missing Health percent you have and the healing is based off your Max Health.
4.name: Pound of Flesh

5.description:
Call souls back from an early grave. Only you may grant them release.

While you are in combat, directly healing a target below |cffffff66|r% Health relinquishes them from death's clutches and allows you to use a corpse consuming ability against them within |cffffff10|r seconds, up to once every second. 

Extends the duration of Major Vulnerability you apply by |cffffff50|r%.
5.name: Veil's Forfeit

1.description:
Expose your enemies to unrelenting cold.

Upgrades Chilled to also apply Major Brittle for |cffffff2.1|r seconds, increasing their Critical Damage taken by |cffffff20|r%.
1.name: Tundra's Maw

2.description:
The battlefield is your grove. Tend to it.

Gain |cffffff333|r Weapon and Spell Damage for each status effect on your target, up to a maximum of |cffffff1665|r.
2.name: Wild Adaptation

3.description:
Tap into the wellspring of permafrost's resolve.

Upgrades Bond with Nature to also activate when casting Winter's Embrace abilities and to grant |cffffff15|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff10|r seconds if you are at full Health after the heal.
3.name: Glacial Obstinance

4.description:
The twisting of seasons has tempered your will.

Reduce your damage taken by |cffffff3|r% for every status effect active on your attacker, up to a maximum of |cffffff15|r%.
4.name: Green-Keeper's Hide

5.description:
Share in the spoils of nature's abundance.

Upgrades rank 2 of Nature's Gift to grant you and your group members Major Heroism for |cffffff3|r seconds and an additional |cffffff125|r Magicka and Stamina, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds.
5.name: Bountiful Harvest

1.description:
Light consecrates the ground on which you tread.

Sacred Ground is now applied while you are in your own Nova and Spear Shards, and while Radial Sweep and Solar Barrage are active. While Sacred Ground is active, you heal for |cffffff1465|r Health every |cffffff1|r second. If you are at full Health after being healed from this effect while in combat, you also gain |cffffff2|r Ultimate.
1.name: Bastion of Light

2.description:
Radiant is the shield that pushes back the dark.

While Sacred Ground is active, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff6|r seconds, up to once every |cffffff6|r seconds. The shield absorbs up to |cffffff4131|r damage and provides |cffffff300|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery while active. If the shield breaks, you gain |cffffff10|r Ultimate.
2.name: Devout Guardian

3.description:
Light's banner instills hope. You are its bearer.

Upgrades rank 2 of Illuminate to also grant Bright Harbinger for the duration, which grants |cffffff300|r Weapon and Spell Damage to allies and doubles for you.
3.name: Bright Harbinger

4.description:
Judgement follows in the wake of your radiance.

When rank 2 of Burning Light deals damage, your Templar abilities gain |cffffff1600|r damage done for |cffffff3.1|r seconds. This bonus is halved against players.
4.name: Judgment's Brand

5.description:
Your conviction is unwavering. Light gives no quarter.

Sacred Ground now activates and refreshes itself while Bracing. Increases the amount of damage you can block by |cffffff20|r% while stationary.
5.name: Steadfast Candescence

1.description:
The Night Mistress rewards those who strike without reservation.

Upgrades rank 2 of Hemorrhage to have a chance to generate |cffffff2|r Ultimate while in combat. This effect can occur once every |cffffff0.3|r seconds and the chance is equal to your Weapon Critical chance.
1.name: Nocturnal Inspiration

2.description:
Every strike, every stab, is a step towards execution.

Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by up to |cffffff2000|r, based on your target's missing Health. 

Reduces your damage taken by up to |cffffff20|r%, based on your attacker's missing Health. 

Both effects are halved against targets with Battle Spirit.
2.name: An Eye for Exploitation

3.description:
An assassin is only as good as their reputation.

Increases your Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff25|r%. This effect is reduced to |cffffff5|r% against targets with Battle Spirit.

Increases your maximum Critical Damage and Healing by |cffffff30|r%.
3.name: Above and Beyond

4.description:
This duel will be their last. For you, it's just another dance.

Activating a Nightblade ability while bracing causes you to dodge attacks for |cffffff0.3|r seconds.

Whenever you dodge an attack, your attacker's psyche suffers, increasing their damage taken by |cffffff5|r% for |cffffff5|r seconds, increasing to |cffffff20|r seconds against monsters.
4.name: Cutthroat's Focus

5.description:
Secrets and coin are tools as sharp as the daggers you wield.

Upgrades rank 2 of Transfer to grant group members |cffffff250|r Magicka and Stamina, |cffffff2|r Ultimate, and doubles the Ultimate you gain when it activates.
5.name: Share the Spoils

1.description:
Spellcasting is second nature to you. A skill honed by tireless study.

Upgrades rank 2 of Blood Magic to work with all abilities with a cost, excluding cost per tick abilities, and restores |cffffff229|r Magicka and |cffffff323|r Stamina when it activates. This effect scales off your Max Magicka and Stamina.
1.name: Conservation of Energy

2.description:
Within you is a wellspring of near unlimited power.

Upgrades rank 2 of Exploitation to work with any Sorcerer ability and increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff12|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds. The Weapon and Spell Damage increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1750|r Max Magicka or Stamina you have, whichever is higher.
2.name: Font of Power

3.description:
The battlefield crackles with untapped potential. Make use of it.

When you deal damage with a Sorcerer ability, you have a |cffffff20|r% chance to deal |cffffff1397|r Shock Damage, up to once every |cffffff0.1|r seconds. 

The chance increases by |cffffff1|r% for every |cffffff1|r% missing Health the target has. The total chance is divided by 1 plus every permanent pet you have active.
3.name: Static Reverberation

4.description:
Success is a certainty when nothing is left to chance.

While beginning to use a Sorcerer ability or an ability with a cast time, you gain a damage shield for |cffffff0.5|r seconds that can absorb |cffffff6815|r damage. This effect is based off your Max Health. If the shield does not break, you and nearby group members gain |cffffff6|r% Weapon and Spell Damage for |cffffff20|r seconds.
4.name: Calculated Defense

5.description:
Magicka extends your reach, a benefit to those who fight beside you.

Casting a damage shield on yourself or an ally grants an additional shield that absorbs up to |cffffff3098|r damage for |cffffff4|r seconds and |cffffff225|r Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery for |cffffff12|r seconds. The shield scales off the higher of your Max Health or Max Magicka, and is capped at |cffffff25|r% of the target's Max Health.
5.name: Sphere of Influence

1.description: Your Light and Heavy Attacks damage up to |cffffff3|r other nearby enemies for |cffffff100|r% of the damage inflicted to the primary target.
1.name: Forceful

2.description:
Grants a bonus based on the type of weapon equipped:

Swords increase your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff258|r.

Axes increase your Critical Damage done by |cffffff12|r%.

Maces increase your Offensive Penetration by |cffffff2974|r.

15.description:
Increases your Stamina Recovery by |cffffff4|r% per piece of Medium Armor equipped.

Reduces the cost of Sneak by |cffffff7|r% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped.

17.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff2|r% for each piece of Medium Armor worn.

18.description:
Increases the Movement Speed bonus of Sprint by |cffffff3|r% for each piece of Medium Armor equipped.

Each piece of Heavy Armor does the following:

Increases your Physical and Spell Resistance by |cffffff343|r for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.

22.description:
Increases your Health Recovery by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.

Increases your Max Health by |cffffff2|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor equipped.

24.description:
Increases the Magicka or Stamina your Heavy Attacks restore by |cffffff4|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor worn.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%

25.description:
Increases your healing received by |cffffff1|r% for each piece of Heavy Armor worn.

Current bonus: |cffffff0|r%

26.description:
Removes |cFFFFFF1|r layer of soil or rock from a |cFFFFFF1x1|r area.

Generates: |c19D3FF1 Intuition|r
Maximum Intuition: |cFFFFFF2|r.
26.name: Hand Brush

Indicates how near the Antiquity is to the selected location. 

Can only be used a limited number of times, based on the Antiquity's Difficulty.

Only works on |cFFFFFFthe lowest three layers|r of dirt and rocks. Cannot detect Bonus Loot.

|cFFFFFFUsing Augur does not consume a turn.|r
27.name: Augur

28.description: Treasure Chests will be easier to see when you are |cffffff30|r meters or closer.
28.name: Keen Eye: Treasure Chests

29.name: Improved Hiding

33.description: Reduces bounties you willingly pay to guards and fences by |cffffff30|r%.
33.name: Kickback

34.description:
Adds the selected contiguous group of facets to your area of control.

Consumes 1 turn.
34.name: Scry

35.description: Allows you to scry for Antiquities of up to Simple difficulty.
35.name: Antiquarian Insight

36.description: Allows you to revive once every |cffffff1|r hour without spending a Soul Gem.
36.name: Soul Summons

37.description:
When your Health drops below |cffffff20|r% your soul explodes, dealing |cffffff2012|r Magic Damage to enemies within |cffffff8|r meters of you.

This effect can occur once every |cffffff2|r minutes and scales off your Max Health.
37.name: Soul Shatter

38.description: Killing an enemy has a |cffffff10|r% chance of automatically filling an empty Soul Gem.
38.name: Soul Lock

39.description:
Allows you to feed on an unsuspecting target, killing them and increasing your Vampire Stage. Higher Stages make you a stronger Vampire at the cost of your humanity. Stages decrease over long periods of time. 

Stage 1/2/3/4

Health Recovery: -10%/-30%/-60%/-100%
Flame Damage Taken: +5%/+8%/+13%/+20%
Regular Ability Costs: +3%/+5%/+8%/+12%
Vampire Ability Costs: -6%/-10%/-16%/-24%
39.name: Feed

40.description:
Ignore the Movement Speed penalty of Sneak.

Decreases the time it takes to enter Sneak by |cffffff50|r%.
40.name: Dark Stalker

41.description:
Reduces the cost of Sprint by |cffffff50|r%.

If you continuously Sprint for |cffffff3|r seconds you automatically become invisible.
41.name: Unnatural Movement

Call the weapon of the Dark Brotherhood to your hand and deliver a killing blow to an unsuspecting target. Experience from this target is reduced by 75%.

This ability does not work on players or difficult targets.
42.name: Blade of Woe

43.description: Bounty and Heat resulting from a witnessed Murder or Assault is reduced by |cffffff50|r%.
43.name: Scales of Pitiless Justice

44.description: Grants Major Expedition, increasing your Movement Speed by |cffffff30|r% for |cffffff10|r seconds after killing an enemy with Blade of Woe.
44.name: Padomaic Sprint

45.description: A contact from the Brotherhood provides beneficial items once per day. This contact is located in Outlaw Refuges, the Gold Coast Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary, and the Hew's Bane Thieves Den.
45.name: Shadowy Supplier

46.description: Aggression radius from hostile monsters is decreased by 50% while mounted.
46.name: Shadow Rider

47.description: 15% chance to shroud you when using the Blade of Woe, shielding you from being witnessed and receiving a Bounty.
47.name: Spectral Assassin

48.description:
Allows you to Intimidate NPCs in conversation.

Reduces the Stamina cost of your Fighters Guild abilities by |cffffff15|r%.
48.name: Intimidating Presence

49.description: Allows you to Persuade NPCs in conversation.
49.name: Persuasive Will

50.description: The insight you have gained from the Psijic Order grants you vision of the spiritual world. You can now interact with rifts all throughout Tamriel.
50.name: See the Unseen

51.description: Thieves troves are caches that are located all over Tamriel. They can only be opened by members of the Thieves Guild.
51.name: Finders Keepers

52.description:
Bounty is decreased by |cffffff115|r after |cFFFFFF3|r minutes.
Heat is decreased by |cffffff64|r after |cFFFFFF3|r seconds.
52.name: Swiftly Forgotten

53.description: Stolen items sold at a fence are worth |cffffff10|r% more. Does not apply to Laundering.
53.name: Haggling

54.name: Clemency

55.description: When you have Bounty and are in combat, you have a chance to spot a "Footpad" in a town with a Refuge. Interacting with the Footpad will transport the player safely into the nearest Refuge.
55.name: Timely Escape

56.description: Decreases detection range of Witnesses and Guards by |cffffff10|r%. Witnesses and Guards are thus less likely to notice criminal actions, though this has no impact on the range from which Guards will accost you.
56.name: Veil of Shadows

57.description:
Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage by |cffffff5|r% and Health, Magicka, and Stamina Recovery by |cffffff10|r% for |cffffff10|r minutes after you capture a Lumber Mill, Farm, Mine, or Keep.

Gain Gallop at all times, increasing your Mount Speed by |cffffff15|r%.
57.name: Continuous Attack

58.description:
Increases your experience gain with the Two Handed skill line by |cffffff15|r%.

Increases the duration of any consumed drink by |cffffff15|r minutes.
58.name: Reveler

Critically striking in any form grants you and your group Minor Savagery, increasing Critical Chance by |cffffff6|r% for |cffffff20|r seconds.
4.name: Hemorrhage

5.description: Warp fate when you generate or consume Crux, increasing your Critical Damage and Critical Healing by |cffffff12|r% for |cffffff7|r seconds.
5.name: Fated Fortune

6.description:
You master the warp and weft of your very soul. 

When you restore Magicka or Stamina, your Weapon and Spell Damage increase by |cffffff284|r for |cffffff10|r seconds.
6.name: Harnessed Quintessence

7.description: Your attacks wound the mind with heretical knowledge, increasing damage dealt by Status Effects by |cffffff15|r% and Status Effect Chance by |cffffff55|r%.
7.name: Psychic Lesion

8.description:
What they don't know can kill them. Increase your Physical and Spell Penetration by |cffffff1240|r per Herald of the Tome ability slotted.

Current bonus: |cffffff3720|r.
